mapper.sql: c.id, c.tree_id, c.plot_id, c.prev_status, c.reason, c.status, c.created_at, c.withdrawn_at, t.code AS tree_code, t.variety
mapper.select: SELECT FROM clear_record c LEFT JOIN tree t ON t.id = c.tree_id ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT FROM clear_record c LEFT JOIN tree t ON t.id = c.tree_id WHERE c.tree_id = #{treeId} AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clear_record (tree_id, plot_id, prev_status, reason, status, created_at, withdrawn_at) VALUES (#{treeId}, #{plotId}, #{prevStatus}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{withdrawnAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE clear_record SET status = '已撤回', withdrawn_at = #{withdrawnAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
